scope: Nearest-primary-paper context-information audit for candidate41; not an exhaustive novelty claim

primary_paper.title: Exploring the Bounds of the Utility of Context for Object Detection
primary_paper.metadata_provenance: Paper Search Crossref exact title record
primary_paper.reviewed: Abstract and Introduction: oracle/optimization analysis of contextual detection score information, localization-error limitations and information redundancy after appearance
primary_paper.overlap: Measuring contextual-information headroom and the limits of context before fitting is established methodology. Candidate41 does not claim this principle or mean pooling as innovation.
primary_paper.difference_and_limit: The paper analyzes context-conditioned score ranking; candidate41 checks cross-class signed coordinate residuals after a conventional continuous corrector. Candidate41's mean donor reference is not the paper's maximal-AP bound, and its failed fixed oracle recipe does not prove all context uninformative.

current_claim: No trained image-shared residual model authorized; candidate41 oracle loses to a train-only class-mean reference. No innovation established.
search_limits: Search also surfaced localization calibration, distribution-aware box refinement and task-specific context work. Those metadata/abstract leads have not all been downloaded or fulltext-audited and cannot be used to declare novelty.
